# Tax Audit Evidence Estate

## Objective
Preserve and classify the FY24/25 R&D tax audit evidence without inventing expenditure or eligibility.

## Decisions
- Contractor costs are closed at zero unless supported by source evidence.
- Davies Collison Cave costs are invalidated for the current claim.
- Personal-account business transactions remain director-funded candidates pending classification.

## Evidence
- Two ANZ accounts and two Commonwealth Bank accounts contain mixed personal and business transactions.
- Every accepted transaction requires source account, transaction date, amount, description and evidence reference.
- Travel, accommodation, transport, telephone, utilities and occupancy costs require business-purpose and apportionment evidence.

## Controls
- Preserve original bank-statement bytes and SHA-256 hashes.
- Do not infer a tax deduction or R&D eligibility from merchant name alone.
- Route ambiguous transactions to human review.
- Maintain lineage from statement row to workbook classification and supporting document.

## Dependencies
- Google Drive source inventory.
- Lossless audit workbook.
- Human approval for legal and tax classifications.

## Expected outcome
Produce candidate evidence objects and relationships, submit them to review, and make no filing or financial-system change.
